newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE index up despite some softer share prices.
newsitem.headline: UAE index up despite some softer share prices.

text.p: The index on the United Arab Emirates' unofficial stock market gained a modest 4.21 points in the week to Thursday despite the weakening of some share prices following price modifications, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose to 2,502.84 points from 2,498.63 the previous week.
National Bank of Abu Dhabi's shares closed at 495, up 15 dirhams.
Union National Bank was steady at 360.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained five to close at 950. Abu Dhabi National Hotels Company was up five dirhams at 1,065.
Abu Dhabi Aviation was unchanged at 665 and Al Dhafra Insurance fell five to 860.
